cases.title: Omitted declaration and omitted fields
cases.expected: A host ceiling of 400000 operations / 80000 ms still selects 100000 / 30000 for omitted fields

cases.title: Authorized 60-second request
cases.expected: Source 200000 operations / 60[s] is admitted only when host policy permits both limits

cases.title: Authorized 75-second request
cases.expected: Source 400000 operations / 75[s] resolves exactly to 400000 / 75000

cases.title: Authorized 80-second request
cases.expected: Source 400000 operations / 80[s] resolves exactly to 400000 / 80000

cases.title: Host authority refusal
cases.expected: A source/request/artifact cannot enlarge ordinary 100000 / 30000 host ceilings; reject before body evaluation

cases.title: Invalid fields and literals
cases.expected: Reject zero, negative, boolean, null, nonfinite, exponent, expression, unknown, duplicate and oversized literal forms before unbounded conversion

cases.title: Exact time units
cases.expected: 0.5[s] resolves to 500 ms; submillisecond, wrong-unit and nonintegral-millisecond values reject without rounding

cases.title: Entry ownership and placement
cases.expected: One optional contextual entry-header block only; imported, repeated, empty and misplaced declarations reject

cases.title: Bounded header admission
cases.expected: Long comments, strings with fake declarations and oversized prefix tokens remain bounded; keep original start time and charged work on promotion

cases.title: Operation boundary
cases.expected: A known counted workload succeeds at its exact authorized boundary and refuses the next charge without publishing invalid results

cases.title: Deadline boundary
cases.expected: Controlled monotonic clock proves selected deadline, original start retention, valid equality boundary and refusal after elapsed limit

cases.title: No nested replenishment
cases.expected: Linking, simulation, multiple frames, helpers, export and in-request independent readback consume one remaining allowance

cases.title: Other resource limits
cases.expected: Larger operation/time limits do not enlarge operand bits, caches, cursors, objects, values, output bytes, key/certificate counts or local numerical caps

cases.title: Actual larger workload
cases.expected: Freeze new source, policy and expected geometry/physics first; preserve a 100000-operation failure and authorized larger-budget source-to-export/readback success

cases.title: Candidate source and revision
cases.expected: Candidate declaration participates in source hash and determines the candidate request; current host policy authorizes its execution; a failed candidate preserves accepted source/run/artifact state

cases.title: Saved program reauthorization
cases.expected: New execution under a lower current host ceiling rejects unless source or explicit caller cap fits; old receipt grants no authority

cases.title: Explicit caller reductions
cases.expected: Caller cap <= source request selects that exact cap; caller cap > source request rejects even if host ceiling is larger

cases.title: Request isolation and policy snapshot
cases.expected: Concurrent requests do not share mutable maxima; policy changes affect new worker admissions, while explicit cancellation can revoke active work

cases.title: Cancellation and callbacks
cases.expected: Preserve caller exception identity, cancellation ordering, paid checkpoints and stopped-request outcome; do not claim preemption of blocking callbacks

cases.title: Failure atomicity and valid prefix
cases.expected: Exhaustion/timeout publishes only explicitly valid state and no uncommitted source or artifact; no hidden automatic retry

cases.title: Legacy compatibility
cases.expected: All preexisting tests and fixtures remain unchanged; old bindings still reject raised limits and preserve original defaults, counts and diagnostics

cases.title: Inherited physical semantics
cases.expected: Explicit new binding retains construction, surface, impulse, force and reach behaviors; no skipped profile branches or inferred version ordering

cases.title: Independent supplied-byte authority
cases.expected: Reader validates actual output claims under its real context; altered budget metadata or self-asserted trust cannot authorize resources or bypass validation

cases.title: Idempotency and resume
cases.expected: Same request identity/payload returns its prior receipt; changed budget conflicts; new explicit execution reauthorizes; internal resume never resets allowance

cases.title: Host ceiling below defaults
cases.expected: Omitted source/caller values reject below defaults; an explicitly lower source/request cap can succeed without silently changing defaults

cases.title: Inspectable execution result
cases.expected: Bounded receipt identifies source, implementation, policy, source request, caller cap, ceilings, effective/consumed work, elapsed time and terminal reason

cases.title: Modeled time stays independent
cases.expected: Execution timeout changes do not change authored scene.duration, requested evaluation horizon, export end or sampling rate

cases.title: Original acceptance identity
cases.expected: Original builder/fixtures/limits remain unchanged; no new higher-budget success is counted as passing the historical original28 gate

cases.title: Actual Agent protocol path
cases.expected: Explicit Agent/0.7 discovery, create/edit, evaluate, export/retrieve, status, cancel, hostile input and retry cases execute before that interface is advertised
